description:
• Brand introduction: At ADOREEL, we believe in the transformative power of crystal energy to bring balance, positivity, and well-being into everyday life. Our products are designed to help individuals realign their energy, reset their minds, and rediscover their inner strength—all while elevating the ambiance of their personal spaces. From crystal diffusers to personalized gift sets, ADOREEL combines modern elegance with holistic wellness.


• Product description: AuraShine is one of ADOREEL’s standout crystal diffusers, designed to uplift and energize your space. Infused with vibrant crystals, AuraShine channels high-frequency energy to help you stay positive, focused, and motivated throughout the day. Whether you're manifesting your goals, practicing mindfulness, or simply unwinding after a long day, AuraShine is your perfect companion for aligning your energy and brightening your surroundings with both fragrance and crystal-powered vibes.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): 

  • Energy-Boosting Design: AuraShine combines the power of crystals like Clear Quartz with soothing essential oils to promote a balanced and energized atmosphere.
  • Effortless Energy Alignment: Whether for meditation, work, or relaxation, AuraShine diffuses positive energy into your space, helping you stay focused and aligned without complicated setups.
  • Beautiful and Functional: AuraShine not only enhances your energy but also serves as an elegant, eye-catching piece in any room. It’s the perfect blend of style and wellness.

• Payment terms: Payouts are processed weekly, with no minimum threshold, allowing affiliates to profit from every referral they make.


• Other information:

  • High Conversion Potential: With AuraShine’s unique combination of beauty, functionality, and positive energy, it’s a product that resonates with a broad audience, leading to strong conversion rates.
  • Marketing Support: Affiliates will receive a suite of promotional materials, including product images, banners, and suggested copy to make it easy to promote AuraShine.
  • Exclusive Affiliate Discounts: Affiliates will have access to special offers and promotions, further increasing the appeal of AuraShine to potential buyers.
